title: cheilanthes lendigera
intro: Cheilanthes lendigera, commonly known as the fern, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It is widely used in traditional medicine, particularly in India and other parts of Asia, due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, which can help to reduce fever, soothe digestive issues, and even treat certain types of skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Cheilanthes lendigera include its ability to act as a hemostatic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic agent, making it effective in treating wounds, burns, and other injuries. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
